ac4X09.finding: Its accepted example supports the command/Action/attempt-spending interpretation and carrying calculation. It does not supply WTRUE17's scene, a Sphere destination, or Sphere causation. runtimeTest:false limits its evidence claim but does not invalidate the authored interpretation.

planeShift.finding: Plane Shift rejects a known impossible ward before payment. The approved Steed procedure commits its per-attempt resources before ward-caused failure, so a hidden ward is not required to produce a paid denial.

remainingWitnessPredicates.requirement: Bind unchanged WTRUE17, lawful Spellbook Study preparation, available Action/RP/components, the 5-RP Steed cast with actual modifiers and strain history, concentration transition, interruption windows, and original expiry. Bind a separately lawful Sphere caster and support source; do not assume simultaneous concentration that a single actor cannot maintain.

Identify the owner, Steed application, and willing rider; record lawful mounting while the Steed is stationary and adjacent, selected rider position, and available shared Bonus Action. At attempt start the command must be perceptible within 60 feet.

Supply the exact site, plane/frame, coordinates, and reliable prior-knowledge provenance required by the Steed procedure. Supply whole-group arrival volumes, occupancy, support or source-qualified Falling, permissions, and blockers. Neither WTRUE17's profile nor AC4-X09 supplies these facts.

Account for the whole mount, one eligible rider, and every permitted item including melded gear. Rider body plus gear must be within both 350 lb and 12 Load. WTRUE17 with only its recorded aggregate kit preliminarily totals 170 lb / 7 Load, leaving the Steed Burdened at Speed 50; itemized custody, dimensions, and fit remain necessary. The mount's 500-lb body is separate from the payload calculation.

Bind Q23–Q25: paid Sphere establishment, consent of every enclosed creature, exact membership, body/item/solid clearance, lawful support, and an uninterrupted closed boundary at crossing. Existing Levitate support cannot be extended to the mount/rider group without a source.

Resolve every non-Sphere prerequisite. On the Steed's attached phase, spend its Action and crossing attempt 1→0 at attempt start. Show the Sphere as the actual exclusion cause; retain the entire group at origin with positions/custody preserved; no arrival, refund, attempt restoration, or automatic source ending. Preserve command/casting costs, concentration, independent deadlines, and complete forward/inverse state restoration.
